SELECT DISTINCT l.* FROM CUST_TRANSFER_LOG l LEFT JOIN CUST_TRANSFER_TARGET t ON t.transfer_id = l.id LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER_MARKET_CUSTOMER c ON c.id = l.cust_id WHERE 1=1
AND (l.from_org_id = #{orgId} OR l.primary_to_org_id = #{orgId} OR t.target_org_id = #{orgId})
AND (l.transfer_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.from_manager_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.target_emp_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY l.created_time DESC
